scope: Comparison of published ASWING theory/manual/DAE plot with source and existing release profile. No ASWING executable run, new performance benchmark or browser release.

findings.implementation: A=R_z; M=-R_zdot; B=R_u; (i omega M-A)x=B. Unit harmonic input; full coupled descriptor retained.

Frequency constructor solves/checks a base then creates a fresh dynamic tangent with fourth-order full-residual probes and selected independent groups. It does not reuse a complete converged Newton Jacobian.
findings.qualification: Documents establish Jacobian reuse, not that every derivative in the licensed executable is analytic.

findings.implementation: Each frequency/input uses real/imaginary positive/negative perturbations. Each snapshot calls DynamicSystem.residual then network_result, which evaluates the network residual again. Rate and input feedthrough must be preserved.

findings.assessment: Default does not reproduce published DAE flight response
findings.implementation: Browser default fixed frame; published plot has nonzero aircraft yaw/roll rates, sideslip and bank.
findings.qualification: Nonzero motion rules out an entirely fixed aircraft frame; the complete reference constraint list and trim are unknown.

findings.assessment: All declared controls agrees; extra default gust differs
findings.reference: manual BODE commands N, F, I
findings.implementation: All flaps, engines and one gust by default. Published DAE display is unit rudder Flap 3. ASWING N computes all declared inputs; gusts are enabled separately.
Browser 0.1–100 rad/input T, 21 samples; reference 0.1–10 cycles/s. Matching endpoints requires 0.2*pi–20*pi rad/s. Exact reference sample grid unknown.
Steady theory lags selected influence geometry dependencies in Newton iterations for a banded structural block. OpenSwing Bode retains physical geometry derivatives and uses generic sparse LU.
findings.qualification: Lagging within nonlinear iterations does not justify deleting terms from the final harmonic tangent. Exact licensed implementation unverified.

findings.implementation: Objective SO(3) midpoint rotations and nodal force/moment equilibrium rather than Euler-angle averages. Internal regression is not proof of ASWING parity.
One value per interval default; Fourier counts optional. Drela describes Fourier representation as typically more efficient. Reducing modes requires convergence evidence.

evidence.profile_scope: DAE 8 intervals per beam; fixed frame; 21 frequencies; 4 inputs; prior candidate-04 release
